name: Khan Academy
description: Mastery-based video lessons and practice from early math through calculus, plus science, history, grammar, economics and computing. Optional free accounts track progress; parent dashboard.

name: Khan Academy Kids
description: Free app with early reading, phonics, writing, math and social-emotional activities for ages 2-8.

name: CK-12 FlexBooks and Practice
description: Free customizable digital textbooks, adaptive practice, simulations and videos for math and science (K-12), with some ELA and social studies.

name: OpenStax
description: Peer-reviewed free textbooks including AP/college-level biology, chemistry, physics, precalculus, statistics, U.S. history, economics, psychology.

name: Open Up Resources 6-8 Math
description: Openly licensed, problem-based middle school math curriculum (based on Illustrative Mathematics) with teacher guides and student materials.

name: Zearn Math
description: Free self-paced digital math lessons aligned to a K-8 curriculum; free for families with a parent account.

name: Mathematics Vision Project
description: Free, openly licensed integrated and traditional high school math (Math I-III / Algebra I-II, Geometry) with student and teacher materials.

name: Core Knowledge free curriculum (CKLA, CKHG, CKSci)
description: Free downloadable Core Knowledge Language Arts, History and Geography, and Science units with teacher guides and student readers.

name: EL Education K-8 Language Arts
description: Free open-licensed, knowledge-building ELA curriculum with modules, texts lists and lesson plans.

name: Easy Peasy All-in-One Homeschool
description: Free day-by-day online curriculum (180 lessons per course) linking to free web resources. Christian worldview; high school version at allinonehighschool.com.

name: AmblesideOnline
description: Free Charlotte Mason-style curriculum plan and book lists using many public-domain living books. Christian orientation.

name: MIT OpenCourseWare
description: Free MIT course materials, lecture videos and problem sets, including resources useful for advanced high school STEM.

name: Desmos Graphing and Scientific Calculators
description: Free online graphing, scientific, geometry and matrix calculators; same calculator embedded in CAASPP and SAT.

name: GeoGebra
description: Free dynamic math apps for geometry, algebra, graphing, 3D and probability, with thousands of shared classroom activities.

name: Polypad
description: Virtual manipulatives (fraction bars, algebra tiles, number lines, geometry tools) for hands-on math.

name: Math Learning Center Apps
description: Free virtual manipulative apps: number rack, number line, fractions, geoboard, money pieces, pattern shapes.

name: Art of Problem Solving Alcumus
description: Free adaptive problem-solving practice for strong math students, from prealgebra through precalculus and contest math.

name: Math is Fun
description: Clear explanations, interactive examples and puzzles from arithmetic through calculus.

name: Math-Drills
description: Thousands of free printable math worksheets with answer keys (facts, fractions, measurement, algebra).

name: K5 Learning free worksheets
description: Free printable worksheets for math, reading comprehension, vocabulary, grammar, spelling and science; paid online program optional.

name: PhET Interactive Simulations
description: Free research-based HTML5 simulations for physics, chemistry, biology, earth science and math.

name: HHMI BioInteractive
description: Free biology and environmental science short films, interactive modules, data activities and virtual labs.

name: Learn.Genetics
provider: University of Utah Genetic Science Learning Center
description: Interactive genetics, cell biology, neuroscience and ecology modules and virtual labs.

name: ChemCollective Virtual Labs
description: Free virtual chemistry lab, scenario-based learning and concept tests.

name: The Physics Classroom
description: Tutorials, interactive simulations, concept builders and practice problems for high school physics.

name: Concord Consortium STEM Resource Finder
description: Free open-source models, simulations and activities in physical, life and earth science, engineering and math.

name: Science Buddies
description: Hundreds of free science fair project ideas, lesson plans and engineering design activities with step-by-step instructions.

name: NASA STEM Learning Resources
description: Lesson plans, videos, activities and images on space, earth science and engineering.

name: NOAA Education
description: Ocean, weather, climate and coastal lesson plans, datasets and multimedia.

name: USGS Educational Resources
description: Earthquake, water, volcano and mapping resources and real data; highly relevant to California earth science.

name: Wonderopolis
description: Daily 'Wonder of the Day' articles with vocabulary and activities to spark curiosity across subjects.

name: Stellarium Web
description: Free browser planetarium showing the real sky for any location and time.

name: California Academy of Sciences - Educators
description: Free lesson plans, videos and activities on biodiversity, climate and California ecosystems.

name: Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary - Classroom Resources
provider: NOAA Office of National Marine Sanctuaries
description: Lesson plans, distance learning programs and virtual reality lessons about California's Monterey Bay marine ecosystems.

name: Smithsonian Learning Lab
description: Millions of Smithsonian images, recordings and texts plus teacher-made collections; free account to save.

name: Library of Congress - Teachers
description: Primary source sets, analysis tools and lesson plans from the nation's library.

name: DocsTeach
description: Thousands of National Archives primary documents with interactive activities for U.S. history and civics.

name: Calisphere
description: Over two million digitized photos, documents and recordings from California libraries, archives and museums, with curated primary source sets aligned to California history.

name: Online Archive of California
description: Finding aids and digitized collections from California archives, libraries and historical societies.

name: California State Library
description: State library collections, California history room, digitized collections and statewide programs offered through local public libraries.

name: California History-Social Science Project
description: Free lessons and resources aligned to the California History-Social Science Framework.

name: iCivics
description: Free civics games and lesson plans on government, the Constitution and citizenship.

name: Digital Inquiry Group (Reading Like a Historian)
provider: Digital Inquiry Group (formerly Stanford History Education Group)
description: Document-based history lessons and civic online reasoning lessons for evaluating online information.

name: OER Project
description: Free online world history, Big History and U.S. history courses with readings, videos and activities.

name: National Geographic Education
description: Maps, articles, lesson plans and the MapMaker tool for geography and earth science.

name: Seterra Geography Games
description: Map quizzes for countries, capitals, U.S. states, California counties and more.

name: Annenberg Classroom
description: Videos and lessons on the Constitution, landmark Supreme Court cases and civic rights.

name: Next Gen Personal Finance (NGPF)
description: Free semester personal finance course and activities; California now requires a personal finance course for high school graduation (phased in for the class of 2031).

name: Crash Course
description: Fast-paced video courses in world and U.S. history, biology, chemistry, literature, economics, government and more.

name: PBS LearningMedia
provider: PBS and KQED / California public media
description: Thousands of curated videos, interactives and lesson plans; California stations add local content.

name: CommonLit
description: Free library of reading passages with questions, discussion prompts and assessments; full ELA units for grades 6-12.

name: ReadWriteThink
provider: National Council of Teachers of English
description: Lesson plans, printouts and interactive tools for reading and writing instruction.

name: Purdue Online Writing Lab (OWL)
description: Authoritative guides to grammar, essay writing, research and MLA/APA citation.

name: Storyline Online
description: Award-winning picture books read aloud by actors, with activity guides.

name: Unite for Literacy
description: Free online picture books with narration in many languages, including Spanish.

name: Project Gutenberg
description: Over 70,000 free public-domain ebooks, including classic literature on most homeschool reading lists.

name: LibriVox
description: Free public-domain audiobooks read by volunteers.

name: Open Library
description: Borrow digitized books online for free with an account.

name: Libby (public library ebooks)
description: Borrow ebooks and audiobooks free with a California public library card (most California libraries offer e-cards).

name: Duolingo
description: Gamified practice in Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese and dozens of other languages; free with ads.

name: Language Transfer
description: Free audio courses (Spanish, French, German, Greek, Italian and more) teaching language by thinking through structure.

name: Spanish Proficiency Exercises
description: Video clips of native speakers demonstrating grammar and vocabulary tasks for Spanish learners.

name: Lifeprint ASL University
description: Free American Sign Language lessons, vocabulary dictionary and video courses (ASL counts as a world language for many California A-G requirements).

name: Code.org
description: Free computer science courses from elementary block coding through AP Computer Science Principles and A.

name: Scratch
description: Block-based programming to create stories, games and animations; huge sharing community and tutorials.

name: CS50 (Harvard)
description: Harvard's free introduction to computer science, plus CS50 for AP CSP and Python/web/AI courses.

name: freeCodeCamp
description: Free interactive curriculum in web development, JavaScript, Python and data science with certifications.

name: Typing.com
description: Free keyboarding lessons and tests, plus digital literacy and coding basics.

name: Chrome Music Lab
description: Browser experiments for exploring rhythm, melody, harmony and sound.

name: musictheory.net
description: Free music theory lessons and ear training/note reading exercises.

name: Carnegie Hall Musical Explorers
description: Free digital music curriculum introducing songs and musical traditions from around the world.

name: Smarthistory
description: Free art history essays and videos covering global art; aligned with AP Art History.

name: Getty Education
description: Lesson plans and curricula connecting art and other subjects using Getty collections (Los Angeles).

name: Google Arts & Culture
description: High-resolution artworks, virtual museum tours and cultural stories from thousands of institutions.

name: OPEN Physical Education Curriculum
provider: OPEN (US Games / BlueCross BlueShield of Kansas City)
description: Free standards-based PE curriculum modules, lesson plans and activity cards for K-12.

name: DAREBEE
description: Thousands of free printable workouts and fitness programs requiring no equipment.

name: GoNoodle
description: Movement and mindfulness videos to get kids active; free family access.

name: KidsHealth
description: Doctor-reviewed health articles for kids, teens and parents, plus free teacher guides by grade.

name: CDE Curriculum Frameworks
description: California's official curriculum frameworks (ELA/ELD, math, science, history-social science, arts, health, PE, world languages, CS) with grade-level guidance and sample lessons.

name: California Content Standards
description: State Board-adopted content standards by subject and grade; useful for building a course of study.

name: CDE Recommended Literature List
description: Searchable list of recommended books for pre-K through grade 12 by grade span, genre and language.

name: CAASPP Practice and Training Tests
provider: California Department of Education / Smarter Balanced
description: Free public practice and training tests for the California state assessments (ELA, math, CAST science) using the real test interface; guest login.

name: Smarter Balanced Sample Items
description: Searchable sample test questions with scoring rubrics for grades 3-8 and 11.

name: California High School Proficiency Exam (CHSPE)
description: Official information on the CHSPE (certificate equivalent to a California high school diploma) with practice tests and eligibility rules.

name: Official Digital SAT Prep
description: Free official SAT practice lessons and questions.

name: Bluebook practice tests
description: College Board's testing app with full-length adaptive SAT and PSAT practice tests.

name: AP Students
description: Course and exam descriptions, past free-response questions and scoring guidelines for every AP subject.

name: ACT free test prep
description: Free ACT practice test and preparation guides.

name: California State Parks PORTS distance learning
description: Free live and recorded virtual field trips to California state parks with standards-aligned lessons.

name: California Learning Resource Network (CLRN)
provider: California Department of Education / Stanislaus County Office of Education
description: Former statewide clearinghouse of reviewed electronic learning resources. Its review program ended in June 2014 due to state funding changes; the site still hosts general academic and ed-tech information. Use for historical reference only.
